description: Looks at the first Solana slot where a token mint appears (public RPC): if its history fits in 8 pages of signatures, it counts the distinct fee payers of the transactions in that slot. Several different fee payers in one slot is a bundle-sniping signal, not proof. Mints with longer history return HISTORY_TOO_LONG; this tool cannot see Jito bundle metadata. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

mint.description: Solana token mint address (base58, 32 to 44 characters)
